query: SELECT id, owner_id, visibility AS "visibility: _", occurred_at AS "occurred_at: _", text_ciphertext, created_at AS "created_at: _", updated_at AS "updated_at: _", deleted_at AS "deleted_at: _" FROM journal_entries AS entry WHERE owner_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ($2::text IS NULL OR visibility = $2) AND ($3::timestamptz IS NULL OR occurred_at >= $3) AND ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR occurred_at < $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entry_emotions AS marked WHERE marked.entry_id = entry.id AND marked.emotion_id = $5)) AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR (occurred_at, id) < ($6, $7)) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $8
